summary: VLAN segmentation task completed via Ansible: node2 on VLAN10, node3 on VLAN20, node1 (VyOS) routing between them. Restart-evidence protocol completed on all four nodes.
actions_performed: Configured VLAN sub-interfaces via Ansible on node2 (VLAN10) and node3 (VLAN20)
Configured VyOS router node1 with vif 10/20 sub-interfaces for inter-VLAN routing
Fixed a boot-time ifupdown/8021q race with a self-healing systemd unit
Restarted node1, node2, node3, node4 one at a time and verified boot-identity change and recovery

evidence.summary: VLAN sub-interfaces and routing verified working end to end
boot_id changed and recovery verified on node1, node2, node3, node4
